_comment: Manual overrides for the DRAFT: clause text when OCR misses discipline icons or returns a garbled snippet. Key is the card name (case-insensitive). Remove an entry to fall back to the OCR-cleaned text.
Aid From Bats: DRAFT: Do not replace until after combat. Maneuver.
Anonymous Freight: DRAFT: As above, but ignore requirements of the equipment.
Arms Dealer: DRAFT: [brujah] As above, but the Arms Dealer can also search your ash heap.
Awe: DRAFT: [pot] This vampire gains X votes.
Body Flare: DRAFT: Only usable in combat with an ally or younger vampire. Strike: 2 aggravated damage.
Bribes: DRAFT: [pre] As above and this vampire gets +1 vote.
Carrion Crows: DRAFT: [pot] As [ani] above, but only for this round.
Consanguineous Boon: DRAFT: As above, but choose two clans.
Cryptic Mission: DRAFT: [pot] D Inflict 1 damage on a minion and enter combat with them.
Cryptic Rider: DRAFT: The next referendum a vampire you control calls before the end of your next turn passes automatically.
Dog Pack: DRAFT: [gangrel] As above, and they cannot strike: dodge.
Earth Meld: DRAFT: [tha] Strike: dodge, with 1 optional press, only usable to continue the combat.
Faceless Night: DRAFT: This acting vampire burns 2 blood to get +1 stealth.
Far Mastery: DRAFT: Search your library for a retainer or ally and move that card to your hand (discard afterward).
Flurry of Action: DRAFT: +1 stealth action. Discard up to three cards (draw afterward).
Force of Will: DRAFT: [aus] +1 stealth action. This vampire untaps.
Forced Vigilance: DRAFT: Reduce a bleed against you by 2.
Form of the Bat: DRAFT: [ani] This vampire gains 1 maneuver during the combat this action.
Gather: DRAFT: [gangrel] As above, but you can choose Gangrel the same age or older.
Guard Dogs: DRAFT: This reacting vampire can play reaction cards and attempt to block as though untapped until the current action is concluded.
Meat Cleaver: DRAFT: [brujah] Strike: strength+1 damage; with optional maneuver each combat; only usable to get to close range.
My Enemy's Enemy: DRAFT: Requires a ready vampire. As [AUS] above, but not useable on an older vampire.
Obedience: DRAFT: As [dom] above, but do not replace until your untap phase.
Permanent Vacation: DRAFT: As above, but chose a vampire with a capacity below 4 to remove from the game.
Protected Resources: DRAFT: As above, but don't burn this card unless your minion bleeds for 2 or more.
Scorn of Adonis: DRAFT: [toreador] As above, and gain pool if the referendum passes.
Summoning, The: DRAFT: [PRE] As [PRE] above; but ignore the requirements of the ally.
Swallowed by the Night: DRAFT: [Combat] Do not replace until after combat. Maneuver.
Thing: DRAFT: Draw 1 card from your crypt.
